name: Lineups content is reachable by scrolling the match page
description: When a visitor scrolls a match detail page to the lineups area, the lineups content is present in the document and surfaces a formation label for at least one team, confirming the section exists even when implemented as an inline section rather than a switchable tab.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab if present, otherwise scroll down to the lineups region of the page
Verify the lineups region is present in the document and surfaces a formation label for at least one team rendered as visible text
